findings.why: Viteria Lanzo does not appear in the supplier master, the qualification records or the capability list. Owner to answer: supplier quality manager (L. Bianchi) / purchasing (G. Ferri). Is the supplier known, qualified and audited? Without that, its standing and its casting capability cannot be assessed.

sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The approved supplier list has no entry for Viteria Lanzo on HB-620, for PLT-PIN or for CUST-NOR. The only current approval is Fonderia Pellice (APR-011). There is no controlled record for this supplier at all, so absence cannot be read as 'not approved'. Owner: supplier quality manager (L. Bianchi).

sources.quote:
5.1 A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before
the first shipment.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to program PRG-Y, which is a Nordhavn program. A new source is a change of source, so written Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) is needed before the first shipment. Nothing in force covers it. The Pellice approval is a different supplier.

sources.quote:
4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate on file from Viteria Lanzo for MAT-ALSI9CU3, the drawing material of HB-620. Owner: supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo).
